description: Lists the pages in the library, most recent first, paginated. Optional filters: tag and folder prefix. Compact fields by default (slug, title, visibility, updatedAt, version, tags); fields='full' returns all metadata. When nextCursor is not null, pass it as cursor to get the next page. Read-only.

prefix.description: Folder path to scope the results to (e.g. 'clients/acme')

name: outbox_list
title: Outbox: list pages
